PROGRAM MANAGEMENT Ensures up to date knowledge of practice standards, protocols, procedures and most recent research applicable to stroke care. In collaboration with the program director, develops and implements standards of care and practice pursuant to stroke program certification indicators. Conducts rounding on patients and communicates with multidisciplinary team members regarding aspects of standards of care and application of clinical practice guidelines. Demonstrates, via role modeling and consultation, advanced knowledge and practice in stroke patient care. Works with and serves as a stroke resource to staff, as appropriate. Participates in hospital wide committees and task forces as required for stroke program management
